GetPriceForCreateInstance.engine:
Engine type. Default is 2. Valid values:
Redis in-memory: 2
Redis capacity: 3
GetPriceForCreateInstance.clusterType:
Cluster type. Default is master_slave. Valid values:
Redis in-memory Standard Edition: master_slave
Redis in-memory Cluster Edition: cluster
Redis capacity (PegaDB) Cluster Edition: cluster
Memcache: default
GetPriceForCreateInstance.nodeType:
Instance specification.
Required for Redis in-memory and Redis capacity types. Obtain specific specifications via the [Get Instance Specification List](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/SCS/s/ikhvw6dqg) API.
Optional for Memcache; this parameter is invalid.
GetPriceForCreateInstance.cacheInstanceType:
Memcache node specification. Unit: GB.
Valid values: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64.
GetPriceForCreateInstance.replicationNum:
Number of replicas. Default is 1. Valid range: 1-10.
Valid for Redis in-memory and Redis capacity types.
Invalid for Memcache.
GetPriceForCreateInstance.diskType: Storage disk type. Valid when purchasing Redis capacity (formerly PegaDB). Default is cloud_hp1.
GetPriceForCreateInstance.diskFlavor: Storage disk capacity per shard. Required when purchasing Redis capacity (formerly PegaDB).
GetPriceForCreateInstance.chargeType:
Billing type. Default is pay-as-you-go (postpay). Valid values:
Subscription: prepay.
Pay-as-you-go: postpay.
GetPriceForCreateInstance.period: Billing cycle. Required when billing type is subscription. Unit: month. Default is 1.
GetPriceForCreateInstance.timeUnit:
Billing unit. Default is MONTH for subscription; MINUTE for pay-as-you-go. Valid values (case-sensitive):
Year: YEAR
Month: MONTH
Day: DAY
Hour: HOUR. Supported only for pay-as-you-go.
Minute: MINUTE. Supported only for pay-as-you-go.
